property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer always successfully calls the callee function with signature transferFrom(address,address,uint256) (so the external calls succeed and transfer returns true); the mutant changes the selector to transfer(...), causing the external call to likely fail for some callee contracts and thus transfer to revert/fail for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the selector computed to a different signature so external call likely reverts while original succeeded.
